title: chessformer_lens: an interpretability lens for square-token chess transformers
description: A toolkit and visualizer for mechanistic interpretability of transformer-based chess models that tokenize the board by square, with Maia-3 and Leela Chess Zero BT4 backends. Provides an interp core (hooks, logit lens, causal head and neuron ablation, depth traces) plus an interactive app: live attention, a neuron panel, and a one-move analysis of the logit lens, causal heads and causal neurons.
